input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。孟子才十一岁，成为一个哲学家。孟子不是祭拜，而是看政治文章，难怪他成为了哲学家。不过，看过很多政治文章对他害得，他有很多问题。

This scene:
他一直问问题，但是不能解决那些问题。孟子长大，他开始能解决问题。他常常建议你不是学金融，而是学政治，因为如果你懂政治，你会成为高薪。后来孟子成为教授，他教学生很厉害。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子长大，他开始能解决问题：长大以后，delete他，redundant
- 他常常建议你不是学金融，而是学政治：建议人们，不要学金融
- 因为如果你懂政治，你会成为高薪：delete the second你，redundant; 得到高薪，成为 + profession/celebrity

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 不是学金融，而是学政治：不要学金融，而要学政治，A recommendation between two choices normally uses a negative command and a positive alternative; the original contrast pattern is for correcting a mistaken claim rather than giving advice. [teacher rule: bushi_ershi]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 成为高薪：拿到高薪，This word names pay, not a profession or identity that someone can become; the correction expresses receiving high pay. [rule: word_choice]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他开始能解决问题：孟子长大了，开始能解决问题，After naming the character in the same sentence, use zero form rather than repeating a pronoun when no other character competes as the subject. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 建议你：建议大家，No listener has been introduced, so the second-person pronoun unexpectedly addresses the reader; name the intended general audience instead. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他教学生很厉害：教学生很厉害，After naming the character in the same sentence, omit the repeated pronoun because the subject remains clear. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟子长大：孟子长大了，Growing up is a completed change of state before the next action begins, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟子成为教授：孟子成为了教授，This is a completed change of status in the past, so use 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 如果你懂政治，你会拿到高薪：如果懂政治，就会拿到高薪，A conditional relation needs the result marker 就 in the second clause; the omitted subject can refer back to the general audience. [rule: none]

items.reason: For advice, the teacher requires 不要……而要…… rather than 不是……而是…….
高薪 is pay and cannot be the complement of 成为; 拿到高薪 is correct.
After 孟子 has been named in the same sentence, 他 is redundant and can be omitted.
The unintroduced 你 improperly addresses the reader, while 大家 gives a suitable general audience.
孟子 is already the clear subject in the same sentence, so repeating 他 is redundant under the teacher's reference rule.
Growing up is completed before the following ability begins, so 长大了 correctly marks the change.
Becoming a professor is a completed past change of status, so 成为了 is correct.
The teacher requires 就 in the result clause of an 如果 conditional.
